admission.justification: One test pins that a colliding map refuses alignment, so a future allocation change that writes duplicate numbers fails before it lands.

applicability: Every reference-number allocation of an aligned card.
conditions: Both number maps are verified injective per side; a collision fails the card closed into a rule-7 skip.

evidence: Rationale: after allocation both number maps are checked injective per side, and a collision fails the card closed into a rule-7 skip instead of writing duplicate numbers. Observed: test_a_repeated_number_refuses_alignment passes a colliding map and requires None.

statement: Rule 7 collision guard: number assignment is verified injective per side and fails closed
